title: Licence allow-list tool
goal: A check that fails on a production dependency with a licence outside the allow-list
acceptance: `tools/check-licences.mjs` and `npm run check:licences` read the production dependencies (`--omit=dev` equivalent) with their SPDX licence, fail on one outside `docs/licences.json` or unknown, and understand `OR` expressions
Fixtures (invented lock data): all allowed, one disallowed, unknown, dual-licensed `MIT OR GPL-3.0-only`, dev-only dependency ignored
The current dependency tree passes, or each exception is listed with its reason
Failing test committed first: the disallowed and unknown fixtures expect exit 1 against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h plus failing-first fixtures and the first pass over the tree. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
